{{Quote|My father fell, too, even though he was blameless.|Kaminne Sihn|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] [[Kaminne Sihn|Kaminne]] and [[Olianne Sihn]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]. They belonged to the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Backlash" />

In [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]], an [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|uprising]] of the clan's male [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] occurred which resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of over two-thirds of the clan's population. Sihn's father was among those who perished.<ref name="Backlash" />
